question: In May 2025, which Indian institute collaborated with INRIA Saclay to develop AI tools aimed at combating antimicrobial resistance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIIT-Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In May 2025, the **Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT-Delhi)** collaborated with INRIA Saclay, a renowned French research institution, to develop AI tools for combating antimicrobial resistance (AMR).
 
• This collaboration aims to leverage **artificial intelligence and machine learning** to analyze large datasets related to microbial infections and drug resistance patterns.
 
• The partnership focuses on creating innovative computational models to predict the emergence of AMR and facilitate better decision-making in the use of antibiotics.
 
• Antimicrobial resistance is a growing global challenge, and this initiative seeks to address it by integrating advanced AI techniques with microbiological research.
 
• The project aligns with global efforts such as the **World Health Organization (WHO) Global Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)**

 
 
• AMR occurs when bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites evolve to resist the effects of medications, making infections harder to treat.
 
• It is considered one of the top 10 global public health threats by the WHO.
 
• The integration of AI in combating AMR involves analyzing genomic, clinical, and environmental data to design effective interventions and reduce the misuse of antibiotics.
